id: title:cvolzer3:show full numbers in insight tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds horizontal scrolling and pinned first-column behavior to SQL insight tables on mobile, improving usability for users with narrow viewports.
review.reason: The observed hunks P1.F3.H5 and P1.F2.H4 implement a UI behavior change: P1.F3.H5 calculates layout width and cell padding, while P1.F2.H4 checks scroll properties. This supports the tier 1 classification of a localized, bounded behavior correction rather than a systemic capability or broad architectural change. No tier 2 or 3 evidence is present.
review.uncertainty: The exact implementation and test assertions are not fully visible, and the broader context of the SQL insight module is not provided, so the benefit is inferred rather than demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; this is an observation-only pass.
